Chapter 42: The Long Road

Chapter Text

He had already walked the road ahead, shadowed and afraid.

The gate stood open, and nobody had thought to close it.

Somewhere below, the ninth bell rang twice and then stopped.

By morning the road had swallowed every footprint he left.
